purpose: Ten memorable named non-legendary residents in sparse parts of the map. Terrain explains each creature; none is a quest or shrine.

rules.keeper: Reuse the persistent resident/guardian pattern. Never replace or despawn an entity tagged cobblers.guardian; blackout recovery belongs to that exact Pokemon.
rules.aggression: Bounded local trigger and leash; never change Fight or Flight behavior for the species globally.
rules.reexport: Reapply from source after export through the established RCON resident path, then verify UUID, species, level, persistence, catch rule, trigger and leash.

old_jaw_blackout_check.judgement: Under the current authored rules, it is not economically harsh for a fresh player. Keep level 25. Telegraph danger and offer a bypass.
old_jaw_blackout_check.runtime_proof_needed: Fresh account inventory/balance, current 20% charge, and above-cap catch refusal have not been observed together on staging.
old_jaw_blackout_check.implementation_note: Current blackout code removes positive money without a guardian claim when no eligible item is selected. This does not affect the fresh $0 case; preserve or deliberately fix it during integration.
